## Low-yield expansion - diagnostics, NOT quotas

After the initial A-L and open-world sweeps, measure ordinary-window unique direct X URLs, independent accounts, distinct candidates, weak/empty lanes and official-only/single-source concentration. Perform a second broadening pass if any are true:

- fewer than 12 ordinary-window direct X post URLs;
- fewer than 6 independent accounts;
- fewer than 8 deduplicated candidates;
- 4 or more lanes remain none/uncertain;
- over half of strong candidates are single-source or official-only.

This second pass is mandatory if triggered. Record what you expanded and report low yield honestly even if the counts remain low. Never manufacture candidates or search until a number is artificially met.
